verdict.rationale: Fathom's own marketing pages describe several in-product AI features drawn from users' meeting data: instant AI summaries, AI-generated action items, Deal View insight summaries, AI scorecards, custom summaries and a conversational meeting assistant. Together these cover both the insights and suggestions parts of the story. The MCP connector exposes the data in outside assistants, so it is not credited as in-product. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how these insight features behave (only pricing and homepage bullets), independent or hands-on corroboration, explicit evidence of proactive suggestions beyond action items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
